name: io.github.Lex-API/lexapi-mcp
title: LexAPI
description: EU and national law for AI: EUR-Lex legislation and case law, citation graph, semantic search.

environmentVariables.name: LEXAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LexAPI API key. Get one at https://lex-api.com/dashboard (FREE plan: 500 credits/month).

environmentVariables.name: LEXAPI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the LexAPI base URL. Defaults to https://lex-api.com/api/v1.

environmentVariables.name: LEXAPI_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide every non-read-only tool (webhook create/update/delete/test, citation extraction).

environmentVariables.name: LEXAPI_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline per tool call in milliseconds, retries included (default 55000). Raise only together with the MCP client timeout.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your LexAPI API key>. Get one at https://lex-api.com/dashboard (FREE plan: 500 credits/month).
